{
  "edges": [
    {
      "fromKey": "n-2jmrrk",
      "toKey": "n-1ktiwpt",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The maintenance acceptance signature was not yet signed (condition) at the time of notification, which is a procedural state that contributed to the lack of formal boundary release and potential confusion regarding system status.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the maintenance acceptance signature had been signed prior to notification, would it have prevented or mitigated the air interruption?",
      "competingExplanation": "The lack of a signed signature is an administrative state; its causal link to the physical event depends on whether that specific procedural step was required for system safety at that moment.",
      "evidenceGap": "Evidence needed: Whether the unsigned acceptance directly impacted operational decisions or if it was merely a documentation lag."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-srvaw4",
      "toKey": "n-1ktiwpt",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The temporary instruction attachment field being blank (condition) indicates missing procedural documentation that could have clarified system configuration or required actions during the event.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If a temporary instruction had been attached, would it have provided necessary information to prevent or respond more effectively to the air interruption?",
      "competingExplanation": "The blank field may reflect standard practice for planned maintenance without prior changes; its causal relevance depends on whether an unrecorded change occurred.",
      "evidenceGap": "Evidence needed: Whether a temporary instruction was required due to recent system modifications or if it was optional."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-lzsmwx",
      "toKey": "n-1ktiwpt",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The area directory not establishing valve positions (condition) means operators lacked reliable information about system configuration, contributing to the inability to diagnose or mitigate the air interruption effectively.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the area directory had established valve positions, would it have enabled faster identification of the interruption source?",
      "competingExplanation": "The limitation is inherent to the document type; its causal impact depends on whether alternative sources (e.g., point register) were available or used.",
      "evidenceGap": "Evidence needed: Whether other documents or observations could have compensated for the directory's limitations."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1myxjth",
      "toKey": "n-1ktiwpt",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Upstream pressure stability (condition) suggests the interruption was not due to upstream supply failure but likely a distribution or receiving-end issue, narrowing potential causes.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If upstream pressure had dropped, would it have indicated a different root cause (e.g., compressor failure)?",
      "competingExplanation": "Stable upstream pressure does not rule out distribution system issues; the causal link is indirect and depends on downstream conditions.",
      "evidenceGap": "Evidence needed: Detailed analysis of distribution valves or piping to confirm no hidden failures occurred."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1rww984",
      "toKey": "n-1ktiwpt",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Lack of documented confirmation regarding root cause assessment (condition) indicates incomplete procedural execution, which may have delayed effective response or corrective actions.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If documentation of root cause assessment had been completed, would it have enabled faster resolution or prevention?",
      "competingExplanation": "Documentation gaps may reflect practical constraints rather than procedural failures; causal relevance depends on whether the gap impacted outcomes.",
      "evidenceGap": "Evidence needed: Whether undocumented assessments were performed informally and if they influenced decisions."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1cs3s92",
      "toKey": "n-1ktiwpt",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Desk entries not logging every field operation (condition) means critical operational details may be missing, hindering accurate reconstruction of the event sequence.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If field operations had been logged, would it have provided clarity on the interruption's origin or response actions?",
      "competingExplanation": "Incomplete logging may be standard practice; causal impact depends on whether missing details were critical to understanding the event.",
      "evidenceGap": "Evidence needed: Whether specific unlogged actions (e.g., valve checks) could have prevented or mitigated the interruption."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1ubp9xd",
      "toKey": "n-1ktiwpt",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "RHOB requesting Utilities attendance and work being paused (condition) reflects a response to the air-low indication, but does not explain why the interruption occurred.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If work had not been paused, would the interruption have persisted or caused harm?",
      "competingExplanation": "The pause is a response to the event, not a cause; causal relevance lies in whether alternative actions could have prevented escalation.",
      "evidenceGap": "Evidence needed: Whether pausing work was necessary given system design and operational procedures."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1hmiwux",
      "toKey": "n-1ktiwpt",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Crew holding current qualifications (condition) does not explain the interruption but indicates procedural compliance; however, lack of recent change briefing may have contributed to unfamiliarity with system state.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["7e69d300-c57e-40a8-bb37-35a61073ff33#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If crew had received recent change briefing, would they have recognized or mitigated the interruption better?",
      "competingExplanation": "Qualifications alone do not guarantee situational awareness; causal link depends on whether knowledge gaps existed.",
      "evidenceGap": "Evidence needed: Whether specific system changes were communicated and understood by the crew."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-16kxawb",
      "toKey": "n-1ktiwpt",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "No line opening authorized (condition) means system isolation was not formally initiated, which may have contributed to the interruption's impact on operations.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If a line opening had been authorized, would it have prevented or mitigated the interruption's effects?",
      "competingExplanation": "Line openings are not always required; causal relevance depends on whether isolation was feasible and necessary.",
      "evidenceGap": "Evidence needed: Whether system design allowed for safe isolation without formal authorization."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1gfn1mr",
      "toKey": "n-1ktiwpt",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Alarm AL-44 triggering (event) indicates system detection of the interruption, but does not explain its cause; acknowledgment suggests response initiation.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the alarm had not triggered, would operators have noticed and responded to the interruption?",
      "competingExplanation": "Alarm triggering is a symptom; causal relevance lies in whether alternative detection methods existed.",
      "evidenceGap": "Evidence needed: Whether alarms were sufficient or if additional monitoring was required."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-58uu1f",
      "toKey": "n-1ktiwpt",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Local indication P-R dropping (event) directly reflects the interruption's occurrence, but does not explain its origin; upstream stability suggests distribution or receiving-end issue.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If P-R had not dropped, would the interruption have been avoided?",
      "competingExplanation": "Pressure drop is a consequence; causal relevance lies in upstream or distribution system conditions.",
      "evidenceGap": "Evidence needed: Detailed analysis of pressure sensors and piping to identify failure points."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1qw8yiu",
      "toKey": "n-1ktiwpt",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "RHOB reporting air-low indication (event) is the initial manifestation of the interruption, but does not explain its cause; it triggers response actions.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If RHOB had not reported the indication, would operators have noticed and responded?",
      "competingExplanation": "Reporting is a response; causal relevance lies in system conditions leading to the interruption.",
      "evidenceGap": "Evidence needed: Whether reporting delays or misinterpretations contributed to event progression."
    }
  ],"decision":{"summary":"The analysis identifies multiple procedural and documentation gaps (unsigned acceptance, blank temporary instruction field, directory limitations) as contributing factors that may have hindered effective response.
